Reusable Functions: Create helper methods for API calls to avoid duplication.
Data Management: Externalize test data in JSON/YAML files.
Error Handling: Validate both status codes and response payloads.
Environment Configs: Use separate configs for dev, staging, and prod.
Logging: Capture request/response logs for debugging.
Code Generation: Quickly scaffold CRUD test cases.
Edge Cases: Suggest invalid inputs, missing headers, or expired tokens.
Refactoring: Optimize repetitive code into reusable modules.
Documentation: Auto-generate comments and docstrings for clarity.
